sql: with pm as (select market_ticker, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100 as c, min(created_at) as t0 from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 90 and 95 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-20' group by 1,2), lf as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and status='filled' and side='no' and action='buy'), lo as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and side='no' and action='buy'), g as (select case when series in ('KXGOLDD','KXGOLDW','KXBRENTD','KXBRENTW','KXNATGASD','KXWTI','KXWTIW','KXAAAGASD','KXAAAGASW','KXCOPPERD','KXSILVERD') then 'commodity' when series in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION') then 'win7' else null end as grp, pm.*, (lo.market_ticker is not null) as live_tried, (lf.market_ticker is not null) as live_filled from pm left join lo using (market_ticker) left join lf using (market_ticker)) select grp, case when not live_tried then '1 live never tried' when live_filled then '3 live filled' else '2 live tried, not filled' end as bucket, count(*) as mkts, sum(case when c<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losers, round(sum(case when c<0 then 1 else 0 end)::numeric*100/count(*),1) as loss_pct, round(avg(c)::numeric,2) as paper_c from g where grp is not null group by 1,2 order by 1,2
